## Role in the pipeline

| | |
|---|---|
| **Thesis section** | 3.2 (four-step matching), 3.3.2 (distance categories D0-D4) |
| **Input** | `sdc_participants.rds` (file 1), `compustat_panel.rds` (file 2), Compustat identifier files |
| **Output** | `alliances_focal.rds` (one row per alliance-firm observation), `firmyear_panel.rds` (panel + alliance counts), `link_counts.rds` (numbers for Table 2) |
| **Previous / next file** | `02_firm_data.qmd` / `04_analysis_sample.qmd` |

SDC and Compustat share no firm identifier. Participants are therefore matched
in four consecutive steps (own CUSIP, parent CUSIP, exact name + country,
fuzzy name). Matched alliances are then classified into the five SIC
distance categories and aggregated to firm-year counts.

```{r}
#| label: setup
source("00_config.R")
library(stringdist)
library(countrycode)

tp    <- readRDS(file.path(path, "sdc_participants.rds"))
panel <- readRDS(file.path(path, "compustat_panel.rds"))
```

## 1. Prepare the SDC side: country codes and company names

```{r}
#| label: prep-sdc
# Align country names (SDC) with ISO codes (Compustat)
to_iso <- function(x) {
  fix <- c("Serbia and Montenegro" = "SRB", "Yugoslavia" = "SRB",
           "German Democratic Republic" = "DEU", "Netherlands Antilles" = "ANT",
           "Micronesia" = "FSM")
  out <- countrycode(x, "country.name", "iso3c", warn = FALSE)
  out[x %in% names(fix)] <- fix[x[x %in% names(fix)]]
  out
}
nat <- unique(c(tp$nation, tp$pnation))
nat_iso <- setNames(to_iso(nat), nat)
tp[, `:=`(iso = nat_iso[nation], piso = nat_iso[pnation])]

# Clean company names: upper case, no punctuation, no legal forms
legal_forms <- paste0("\\b(INCORPORATED|INC|CORPORATION|CORP|CO|COMPANY|LTD|LIMITED|PLC|",
                      "AG|SA|SE|NV|BV|GMBH|SPA|S P A|AB|ASA|OYJ|KK|LLC|LP|HOLDINGS?|HLDGS?|GROUP|GRP|",
                      "THE|TBK|PT|BHD|BERHAD|PUBLIC|PCL|JSC|PJSC|OAO|SAB DE CV|DE CV|SAB|NPV|CL A|",
                      "CLASS A|ADR)\\b")

clean_name <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(ifelse(is.na(x), "", x))
  x <- gsub("&", " AND ", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Z0-9 ]", " ", x)
  x <- gsub(legal_forms, " ", x)
  trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", x))
}
tp[, `:=`(n_own = clean_name(name), n_parent = clean_name(pname))]
knitr::kable(tp[1:5, .(name, n_own)])
```

## 2. Prepare the Compustat side: identifiers

```{r}
#| label: prep-cs
data_key <- panel[!is.na(revt), paste(gvkey, fyear)]   # firm-years with revenue

na_id <- unique(fread(file.path(path, "Compustat North America Data.csv"),
                      select = c("gvkey", "cusip", "conm", "fic"),
                      colClasses = list(character = c("gvkey", "cusip")),
                      na.strings = c("", "NA")))
na_id <- unique(na_id[!is.na(cusip), .(gvkey, cusip6 = substr(cusip, 1, 6), conm, country = fic)])

gl_id <- unique(fread(file.path(path, "Compustat Global Data Start 1988.csv"),
                      select = c("gvkey", "conm", "loc"),
                      colClasses = list(character = "gvkey"),
                      na.strings = c("", "NA"))[, .(gvkey, conm, country = loc)])

names_cs <- unique(rbind(na_id[, .(gvkey, conm, country)], gl_id))
names_cs[, n_clean := clean_name(conm)]
names_cs <- unique(names_cs[nchar(n_clean) >= 3, .(gvkey, n_clean, country)])
c(na_ids = nrow(na_id), global_ids = nrow(gl_id), names = nrow(names_cs))
```

## 3. Four-step matching

The **order of the steps matters**: a participant is only matched in the
first step that finds it. In case of doubt, no match is better than a wrong
match: ambiguous candidates are discarded (`pick()`).

```{r}
#| label: match-functions
tp[, `:=`(gvkey = NA_character_, route = NA_character_)]

pick <- function(cand) {
  cand <- unique(cand[, .(id, gvkey, year)])
  cand[, n := .N, by = id]
  cand[, has_data := paste(gvkey, year) %chin% data_key]
  cand <- cand[n == 1 | has_data]
  cand[, n2 := .N, by = id]
  cand[n2 == 1, .(id, gvkey)]
}

assign_match <- function(hits, route_name) {
  hits <- hits[!tp[!is.na(gvkey)], on = "id"]
  tp[hits, on = "id", `:=`(gvkey = i.gvkey, route = route_name)]
  cat(sprintf("  %-26s %7d\n", route_name, nrow(hits)))
}
unmatched <- function(cond) tp[is.na(gvkey) & eval(cond)]
```

```{r}
#| label: match-exact
cat("Matches by route:\n")

# (1) own CUSIP
k <- merge(unmatched(quote(ps == "P"))[, .(id, year, cusip6)], na_id[, .(cusip6, gvkey)],
           by = "cusip6", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
assign_match(pick(k), "NA CUSIP own")

# (2) CUSIP of the ultimate parent
k <- merge(unmatched(quote(pp == "P"))[, .(id, year, cusip6 = pcusip6)], na_id[, .(cusip6, gvkey)],
           by = "cusip6", allow.cartesian = TRUE)
assign_match(pick(k), "NA CUSIP parent")

# (3) exact cleaned name + country, own name then parent name
k <- merge(unmatched(quote(ps == "P"))[, .(id, year, n_clean = n_own, country = iso)], names_cs,
           by = c("n_clean", "country"), allow.cartesian = TRUE)
assign_match(pick(k), "Exact name own")

k <- merge(unmatched(quote(pp == "P"))[, .(id, year, n_clean = n_parent, country = piso)], names_cs,
           by = c("n_clean", "country"), allow.cartesian = TRUE)
assign_match(pick(k), "Exact name parent")
```

```{r}
#| label: match-fuzzy
# (4) fuzzy name matching (Jaro-Winkler distance <= 0.05) with safeguards:
# same country, same first letter, unique best candidate, plausible name pair
plausible <- function(a, b, d) {
  if (gsub(" ", "", a) == gsub(" ", "", b)) return(TRUE)
  wa <- strsplit(a, " ")[[1]]; wb <- strsplit(b, " ")[[1]]
  k <- min(length(wa), length(wb))
  if (identical(wa[1:k], wb[1:k])) return(TRUE)
  d <= 0.035 && wa[1] == wb[1]
}

fuzzy <- function(q, threshold = 0.05) {
  q <- q[nchar(n_clean) >= 4 & !is.na(country)]
  q[, block := paste(country, substr(n_clean, 1, 1))]
  names_cs[, block := paste(country, substr(n_clean, 1, 1))]
  res <- list()
  for (b in unique(q$block)) {
    qn <- unique(q[block == b, n_clean]); dn <- names_cs[block == b]
    if (!nrow(dn)) next
    dmat <- stringdistmatrix(qn, dn$n_clean, method = "jw", p = 0.1)
    if (is.null(dim(dmat))) dmat <- matrix(dmat, nrow = length(qn))
    best <- apply(dmat, 1, min)
    for (i in which(best <= threshold)) {
      g  <- unique(dn$gvkey[dmat[i, ] == best[i]])
      cs <- dn$n_clean[which.min(dmat[i, ])]
      if (length(g) == 1 && plausible(qn[i], cs, best[i])) res[[length(res) + 1]] <-
        data.table(n_clean = qn[i], gvkey = g, cs_name = cs, dist = best[i])
    }
  }
  if (!length(res)) return(data.table())
  merge(q[, .(id, year, n_clean)], rbindlist(res), by = "n_clean")
}

f1 <- fuzzy(unmatched(quote(ps == "P"))[, .(id, year, n_clean = n_own, country = iso)])
assign_match(pick(f1), "Fuzzy name own")        # about 1,800

f2 <- fuzzy(unmatched(quote(pp == "P"))[, .(id, year, n_clean = n_parent, country = piso)])
assign_match(pick(f2), "Fuzzy name parent")     # about 800
```

### Quality check of the fuzzy matches

A random sample of 200 fuzzy matches was checked manually
(`fuzzy_check_marked.xlsx`): 1 error in 149 distinct pairs (0.7%, 95% upper
bound 3.2%). The error was a numbered shell company (GX ACQUISITION II
matched to GX ACQUISITION).

```{r}
#| label: fuzzy-sample
fz <- rbind(f1, f2)[tp[route %like% "Fuzzy", .(id, gvkey)], on = .(id, gvkey), nomatch = 0]
set.seed(42)
fwrite(unique(fz[sample(.N, min(200, .N)), .(sdc_name = n_clean, compustat_name = cs_name, dist)]),
       file.path(path, "fuzzy_check_sample.csv"))
```

### Match rate

Only listed firms (own or parent) can be matched to Compustat, so the match
rate is evaluated for those participants.

```{r}
#| label: match-rate
tp[, listed_link := ps == "P" | pp == "P"]
cat("Listed-linked partners matched:", round(tp[listed_link == TRUE, mean(!is.na(gvkey))], 3), "\n")

knitr::kable(
  tp[listed_link == TRUE, .(matched = round(mean(!is.na(gvkey)), 3)),
     by = .(decade = (year %/% 10) * 10)][order(decade)],
  caption = "Match rate of listed-linked partners by decade")
# 1980s 64.4% -> 2020s 81.1%: older firms are renamed or delisted more often
```

## 4. Focal-firm observations

Each matched participant is treated as a focal firm in its own observation.
Alliances between affiliates of the same parent company are removed.

```{r}
#| label: focal
af <- tp[!is.na(gvkey)]
n_matched <- nrow(af)

# drop intra-group alliances (e.g. parent and subsidiary)
partner_gv <- af[, .(deal, side = 3L - side, partner_gvkey = gvkey)]
af <- partner_gv[af, on = .(deal, side)]
af <- af[is.na(partner_gvkey) | partner_gvkey != gvkey]
n_after_affiliates <- nrow(af)
c(matched = n_matched, after_affiliates = n_after_affiliates,
  removed = n_matched - n_after_affiliates)
```

The focal firm's industry comes from Compustat's **historical SIC code**
(`sich`, filled within firm in file 2), looked up in the alliance year
(or the closest year within +/-2). Firms without any historical Compustat SIC
are excluded instead of falling back on the SDC code.
The partner's industry is the SDC code of the partner.

```{r}
#| label: focal-sic
sich_tab <- panel[!is.na(sich_fill), .(gvkey, fyear, sich = sich_fill)]
af[, fyear := year]
af[, focal_sic := NA_character_]
for (off in c(0, -1, 1, -2, 2)) {
  s <- copy(sich_tab)[, fyear := fyear - off]
  af[is.na(focal_sic), focal_sic := s[.SD, on = .(gvkey, fyear), x.sich]]
}
af <- af[!is.na(focal_sic)]                           # no Compustat SIC in any year -> excluded
af <- af[nchar(focal_sic) == 4 & nchar(partner_sic) == 4]   # both codes need four digits
n_final <- nrow(af)
c(after_affiliates = n_after_affiliates, final = n_final)   # final: 108,295
```

## 5. Industry distance categories D0-D4 (thesis 3.3.2)

`fcase()` is a chain of if-else conditions, and the first match wins: a pair
sharing all four digits becomes D0 and never reaches the later tests; a pair
sharing only the first two digits falls through D0 and D1 and lands in D2.
Related alliances are D0-D3, the unrelated alliance is D4 (different SIC
division).

```{r}
#| label: distance
sic_division <- function(s) {
  x <- as.integer(substr(s, 1, 2))
  cut(x, c(-1, 9, 14, 17, 39, 49, 51, 59, 67, 89, 99),
      labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H", "I", "J"))
}

af[, category := fcase(
  focal_sic == partner_sic,                               "d0_same4",
  substr(focal_sic, 1, 3) == substr(partner_sic, 1, 3),   "d1_same3",
  substr(focal_sic, 1, 2) == substr(partner_sic, 1, 2),   "d2_same2",
  sic_division(focal_sic) == sic_division(partner_sic),   "d3_same_division",
  default =                                               "d4_diff_division")]

dist_tab <- af[, .N, by = category][order(category)][, share := round(N / sum(N), 3)]
knitr::kable(dist_tab, caption = "Alliance-firm observations by distance category (before sample restriction)")
# about half of all alliances are cross-division (D4)
```

```{r}
#| label: save-focal
saveRDS(af[, .(deal, year, gvkey, route, jv, focal_sic, partner_sic,
               partner_ps, partner_pp, partner_nation, partner_gvkey, category)],
        file.path(path, "alliances_focal.rds"))

saveRDS(list(participants = nrow(tp), matched = n_matched,
             after_affiliates = n_after_affiliates, final = n_final),
        file.path(path, "link_counts.rds"))
```

## 6. Aggregate to firm-year counts

For every firm-year: the number of alliances of each distance category,
split by governance form (`_eq` = equity-based, `_ne` = non-equity; `jv` is the equity-based indicator from file 1).

```{r}
#| label: aggregate
af[, gov := fifelse(jv, "eq", "ne")]
counts <- dcast(af, gvkey + year ~ category + gov,
                fun.aggregate = length, value.var = "deal")
# n_jv = number of equity-based alliances (variable name kept from the first version)
jv_c   <- af[, .(n_jv = sum(jv), n_alliances = .N), by = .(gvkey, year)]
counts <- jv_c[counts, on = .(gvkey, year)]
setnames(counts, "year", "fyear")

fp <- counts[panel, on = .(gvkey, fyear)]
cnt_cols <- setdiff(names(counts), c("gvkey", "fyear"))
fp[, (cnt_cols) := lapply(.SD, nafill, fill = 0), .SDcols = cnt_cols]
fp[, ever_alliance := any(n_alliances > 0), by = gvkey]

stopifnot(nrow(fp) == nrow(panel))
c(firm_years = nrow(fp), alliances_in_panel = sum(fp$n_alliances), alliances_linked = n_final)
```

### Alliances that do not land in the panel

Roughly 11,700 of the 108,295 alliance-firm observations cannot be placed in
the panel: about 8,400 are announced after 2024 (SDC runs longer than
Compustat) and about 3,300 fall into firm-years that are missing in
Compustat. None of them is usable anyway, because without a Compustat
firm-year there is no growth rate and no controls.

```{r}
#| label: lost
lost <- counts[!panel, on = .(gvkey, fyear)]
knitr::kable(
  lost[, .(alliances = sum(n_alliances)),
       by = .(reason = fcase(fyear > 2024, "after 2024",
                             !gvkey %chin% panel$gvkey, "firm not in panel",
                             default = "firm in panel, year missing"))],
  caption = paste("Alliances not in the panel, total:", sum(lost$n_alliances)))
```

```{r}
#| label: save-panel
saveRDS(fp, file.path(path, "firmyear_panel.rds"))
```
